fact: The Personal Data Protection Act 2022 was assented to on 27 November 2022, the Commission was established on 1 May 2023 and inaugurated by the President on 3 April 2024, and Tanzania had not yet ratified the Malabo Convention.
title: Legal challenges and constitutional issues on the Personal Data Protection Act, 2022: analysis of the case Tito Magoti v. The Attorney General
